settings.title: Keep one clean side
settings.text: Use one side for clubs and one side for hands or face contact. A cleaner towel keeps the whole setup sharper.

settings.title: Brush before buildup
settings.text: Quick cleaning between shots beats deep cleaning after several rounds.

settings.title: Let gear dry
settings.text: Avoid trapping damp accessories in pockets. Let towels and covers breathe after wet rounds.

settings.question: How often should I clean my golf towel?
settings.answer: For regular players, wash it every few rounds or anytime it starts transferring dirt back onto clubs.

settings.question: How do I keep colors looking matched?
settings.answer: Stick to one accent color and replace the most visible worn pieces first: towel, headcover, and marker.

settings.heading: Keep the setup clean.
settings.subheading: Simple care rules for making towels, brushes, covers, and small accessories look better for longer.
